items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: Jay keeps telling her he’s Jay McShann and she keeps insisting he’s Bobby Bland.

ctx.x: which I heard him do many other times but I didn’t know this at the time but I heard him do this in many other interviews, “Oh well you see I’m writing a book. I’m writing my biography, and I can’t talk about those things that are going to be in the book, so you got any more questions? And of course you can imagine like a 16-, 17-year-old kid that has — and I don’t know what to do. So I kind of re-phrased the question. I guess I don’t know what I said but I kind of re-phrased it. And then Basie goes, “You know…

a younger woman, comes over to Jay and she says, “I know you. My mom has all your records. I know you, you’re famous.” And Jay, you know, you know Jay, Jay was real humble and you know Jay’s like, “Oh well.” “Yeah, yeah, I know who you are. My mom has all your records. I grew up listening to you.” And Jay’s like, “Oh.” She goes, “You’re Bobby Blue Bland.” And so Jay starts trying to convince her that he’s not. And I’m just sitting there cracking up you know. And Jay’s like, “No, no, my name’s Jay.” And she’s…
Oh that’s great. Thank you for that.
